citationText: ETSI documents can be downloaded from the ETSI web server, " http://www.etsi.org/ ". Any 3GPP document can be downloaded from the 3GPP webserver, " http://www.3gpp.org/ ", see specifications. TIA documents can be obtained from "www.tiaonline.org".
